boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented South Orange campus destinations for studying, gathering, recreation, reflection, and student-made work.

cards.title: Set up on The Green
cards.subtitle: In front of the University Center
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or a blanket and use the central lawn for a low-key outdoor study break or conversation when the weather cooperates.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor space for studying and relaxing.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall identifies The Green, in front of the University Center, as a space for outdoor study and relaxing in warmer weather.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; observe University policies and event setups.

cards.title: Meet in The Living Room
cards.subtitle: Bishop Dougherty University Center
cards.notes: Use the University Center gathering area to meet a classmate, compare notes, or work between commitments without needing a formal room reservation.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable University Center gathering area.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall describes The Living Room as a comfortable gathering area for individuals and groups, designed for commuter-student needs.
cards.access_notes: Located in the University Center; building access and room availability may vary.

cards.title: Work beneath the Walsh Rotunda
cards.subtitle: Walsh Library
cards.notes: Choose the Rotunda as a recognizable library meeting point, then move into the building’s study areas with your research group or reading list.
cards.short_summary: A landmark interior within Seton Hall’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall calls the domed Rotunda of Walsh Library an iconic campus landmark and reports that the library offers student study spaces.
cards.source_title: Seton Hall Libraries: Your Partner in Research and Innovation
cards.access_notes: Library access and service hours vary; follow posted library rules.

cards.title: Book a Walsh group room
cards.subtitle: Third and fourth floors of Walsh Library
cards.notes: Reserve a group study room when your project needs a shared screen or a contained space for planning, practice, and collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: Bookable rooms designed for collaborative learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall reports 28 student rooms for group study and collaborative learning, and identifies Microsoft Surface Hub devices in 25 Walsh group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Room booking is required; availability and eligibility are set by University Libraries.

cards.title: Take a quiet reset in the Wellness Room
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Walsh Library
cards.notes: Request the key at the second-floor circulation desk for a brief, device-free reset; keep the visit quiet and leave the space ready for another student.
cards.short_summary: A private library room intended for mindful decompression.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall’s Wellness Room is a private, quiet Walsh Library space for students to unplug, recenter, and practice mindfulness; keys are available at the circulation desk.
cards.access_notes: One student at a time; obtain the key at the second-floor Circulation Desk. It is not a study room.

cards.title: Pause at the O’Brien Family Gallery
cards.subtitle: University Center
cards.notes: Walk through the University Center gallery and spend a few minutes with current student artwork before or after an event, class, or campus meeting.
cards.short_summary: A University Center gallery that displays student work.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall reports that the O’Brien Family Gallery in the University Center displays a curated collection of student work.
cards.source_title: Gallery Space in the New University Center Shows Off Student Work
cards.access_notes: Gallery displays and building access may change with University Center programming.

cards.entity_name: Richie Regan Recreation and Athletic Center
cards.title: Join open recreation at the Regan Center
cards.subtitle: South Orange campus recreation facility
cards.notes: Check recreational programming and join an intramural, club-sport, fitness, or open-recreation activity that fits your schedule and experience level.
cards.short_summary: Campus recreation with fitness, pool, and organized activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall says the Richie Regan Recreation and Athletic Center offers an Olympic-size pool, fitness center, intramurals, club sports, aerobics, and open recreation.
cards.access_notes: Recreational facilities and programs have eligibility rules and changing schedules.

cards.title: Visit the Chapel of the Immaculate Conception
cards.subtitle: South Orange campus
cards.notes: Step into this campus chapel for a reflective pause, and consult the chapel or campus schedule if you plan to attend a service or organized program.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus chapel central to Seton Hall’s spiritual life.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall describes the Chapel of the Immaculate Conception as the “Heart of the Campus” and says its renewal was completed in 2008.
cards.source_title: Welcome to the Immaculate Conception Chapel
cards.access_notes: A worship space; access and services follow chapel and University schedules.

cards.title: Watch activity at Owen T. Carroll Field
cards.subtitle: South Orange campus athletic fields
cards.notes: Check the athletics calendar, then take in a soccer practice or match atmosphere from permitted spectator areas and respect all field-access restrictions.
cards.short_summary: A renovated campus field used by Seton Hall soccer.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall student media reports that Owen T. Carroll Field is home to the men’s and women’s soccer teams and was renovated beginning in 2019.
cards.source_title: How the renovation of Seton Hall’s Owen T. Carroll Field came together
cards.access_notes: Use designated spectator routes and follow athletics event guidance; field access is restricted.

cards.title: Look for a University Center Theatre event
cards.subtitle: Bishop Dougherty University Center
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar for a student program, talk, or performance in the theatre, then confirm entry details with the event organizer before attending.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed theatre within the University Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Seton Hall’s official campus map lists the University Center Theatre as a destination in the Bishop Dougherty University Center.
cards.access_notes: Event access, tickets, and seating are determined by individual programs.
